title: Agent or Workflow Sorter
creator: Dan McCreary
subject: AI Agents for Robotics
description: Sort eight described systems into four classes: ordinary program, chatbot, workflow or agent. The deciding question is who chooses the next step, the code or the model, and whether there are tools. Used in Chapter 15.

educational.topic: Ordinary programs, chatbots, workflows and agents
learningObjectives: Classify eight described systems as an ordinary program, a chatbot, a workflow or an agent, according to who decides the next step and whether tools are used, with at least 7 of 8 correct on the first attempt

pedagogical.teachingStrategy: Classify examples by one rule, with the correct class and the reason shown after each commit
keyQuestions: Who decides the next step, the code or the model?
Does the system have a model, and does the model have tools?
commonMisconceptions: Any program that uses a language model is an agent
A chatbot with a tool is a workflow
A fixed sequence is safe because it uses a model
assessmentOpportunities: Eight committed classifications; 7 of 8 for mastery

controls.label: Start / Check / Next system / See score / Try again
